reason: ms-0197-g1 与 ms-0197-g2 的切分点落在同一个项目符号的句中，而非项目符号边界，导致两个单元各自都不成条款：g1 的 key_text/span 以“After regulatory implementation an initial evaluation of RMM, e.g.”结尾，被截断在“e.g.”之后，只保留了对象（初步评价）却丢掉了该对象的时间窗约束，不是完整条款；g2 的 key_text 以“within 12-24 months to allow the possibility of necessary changes in healthcare; and • Within 4 years of regulatory implementation the overall effectiveness evaluation of the RMM”开头，起首的“within 12-24 months”失去了所修饰的对象（第 19 页原文为“• After regulatory implementation an initial evaluation of RMM, e.g. within 12-24 months…”），同时又把属于第二个项目符号的总体评价时间点并入同一 key，使两个单元既不是最小命中也不保留各自的对象+约束。两段合并后内容虽能回答 query，但当前的强制联合切分依据是排版偏移而非语义，不能证明按此边界“缺一不可”。
suggestion: 按项目符号重新切分为两个 gold：g1 的 key_text 取“After regulatory implementation an initial evaluation of RMM, e.g. within 12-24 months”，g2 的 key_text 取“Within 4 years of regulatory implementation the overall effectiveness evaluation of the RMM”；两者共用同一完整上下文 span“The following timepoints should be considered by marketing authorisation holders for establishing and agreeing schedules with competent authorities: • After regulatory implementation an initial evaluation of RMM, e.g. within 12-24 months to allow the possibility of necessary changes in healthcare; and • Within 4 years of regulatory implementation the overall effectiveness evaluation of the RMM (see XVI.B.5.3.), which, where applicable, can also inform the evaluation of the renewal of a marketing authorisation.”（char_start 1325–char_end 1840），或直接合并为单 gold。
